ELECTRICITY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.

2. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

5. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

6. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.

7. When learning Single Phase AC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Generators.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Generators.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Generators.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

9. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

13. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring Instruments.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring Instruments.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring Instruments.

14. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

16. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Earthing and Excess Current Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Inspection and Testing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
